The cold-pressing technique of extraction does not use heat or air and thus preserves the antioxidants and nutrients present in the oil. It is packaged in PET bottles, which helps keep it as pure as possible and safe to buy our organic coconut oil online. It offers many health benefits and has a delicate taste.

  • Ingredients:100% Pure Coconut Oil

HEALTH BENEFITS OF COCONUT OIL

body_html:

  • Shelf Life: 9 months

title: Almonds / Badaam
body_html:
Almonds are one of the most popular nuts known for their nutritional value rich source of antioxidants and Vitamin E. Our organic Almonds are sourced from the North of Jammu and Kashmir. They are pure, delicious and sustainably sourced. 

  • Ingredients: 100% Almonds  
  • Shelf Life: 6 Months 

HEALTH BENEFITS OF ALMONDS 

  • Rich source of Vitamin E and antioxidants 
  • High in protein and fibre 
  • Helps maintain bone health 
  • Helps manage weight 
  • Just a handful of almonds, contains most of the essential nutrients and minerals required by a person on a daily basis.
USES OF ALMONDS 
  • It can be eaten raw or roasted as a snack 
  • Add them to your cereals and savory dishes
